Label: Air Power
Text: Discard in your Air step to deploy an Air Force or to use Air Superiority.

Label: Navajo Code Talkers
Text: Use at the beginning of your Play step. Take a Bolster card from your hand and place it face down on the table. You may use it as if it were a Response card.

Label: Oil Embargo
Text: Germany, Italy, and Japan must each choose to remove a piece from the board or discard the top 2 cards of its draw deck.

Label: Rangers
Text: Use when you deploy or marshal an Air Force. Discard the top 1 card of your draw deck to eliminate an Army adjacent to that Air Force.

Label: Pappy Boyington
Text: Use at the beginning of your Victory step. Discard the top 1 card of your draw deck to deploy an Air Force in or adjacent to the Central Pacific.

Label: Our Philosophy of Government
Text: Use at the beginning of your Draw step. Discard the top 2 cards of your draw deck to allow the United Kingdom to place a Response card from its discard pile face down on the table.

Label: War Bonds
Text: When you Reallocate Resources, you may take a card from your discard pile instead of your draw deck.

Label: Flying Tigers
Text: Use at the beginning of your Air step. Deploy a Chinese Air Force, or a Chinese Air Force may gain air superiority.

Label: Eagle Squadrons
Text: Use at the beginning of your Air step. The United Kingdom may deploy an Air Force.

Label: USMC
Text: Use when you build a Navy in or adjacent to a sea space with 'Pacific' in the title. Discard the top 1 card of your draw deck to battle a land space adjacent to the Navy just built.

Label: Pacific Bases
Text: Use at the beginning of your Victory step. Discard the top 1 card of your draw deck to recruit an Army in a space adjacent to the Central Pacific.

Label: Shoot First and Argue Afterwards
Text: Build a Navy in a sea space with 'Pacific' in the title, then battle a sea space adjacent to the Navy just built.

Label: The Brazilian Expeditionary Force
Text: Build an Army in Latin America and a Navy in the South Atlantic or the Southern Ocean.

Label: Cash and Carry Replaces Neutrality Acts
Text: Recruit any 1 available Allied Army or Navy in or adjacent to the corresponding country's Home space.

Label: American Public Sympathizes with Chinese People
Text: Build a Chinese Army.

Label: A Great, Sleeping Giant
Text: Use when you build a Navy in a space with 'Pacific' in the title. Discard the top 1 card of your draw deck to build an Army or Navy in an adjacent space.

Label: P-51 Mustang
Text: Use when you play an Economic Warfare card. The country attacked must discard an additional card for each United States Air Force within 2 spaces of the opponent's Home space.

Label: Anti-Japanese Volunteer Armies
Text: Each time a Chinese Army is battled, built, or recruited, the Japanese player must discard 1 card from its hand.

Label: Carpet Bombing
Text: Use when you battle. Discard an Economic Warfare card from your hand to battle the same space again.

Label: Doolittle's Bombers
Text: Use if you have a supplied Navy within 3 spaces of Japan. Japan must discard the top 1 card of its draw deck. Gain 3 Victory Points.

Label: Artificial Harbors
Text: Use once per turn when you build a Navy. Discard the top 1 card of your draw deck to build an Army adjacent to the Navy just built.

Label: SHAEF
Text: France, the United States, and the United Kingdom may trace supply through each other's pieces, including the Army in the Supply space.

Label: Victory Gardens
Text: The United States only has to discard 1 card from its hand to use Reallocate Resources.

Label: Stalemate in China
Text: For each Chinese Army or Air Force on the board, Japan must discard the top 2 cards of its draw deck.

Label: The Hundred Regiments Offensive
Text: Battle a land space adjacent to a supplied Chinese piece.

Label: United States Submarines Patrol Japanese Shipping Lanes
Text: For each United States Navy within 2 spaces of Japan, Japan must discard the top 2 cards of its draw deck.

Label: Admiral Graf Spee
Text: Use when you build a Navy. Discard the top 1 card of your draw deck to battle the North Sea, North Atlantic, or South Atlantic.

Label: Ju-52's Airlift Supplies
Text: Use at the beginning of your Play step. If you have an Air Force on the board, all German pieces are in supply for the rest of the turn.

Label: Operation Weserübung
Text: Use at the beginning of your Victory step. Discard the top 1 card of your draw deck to recruit an Army in Scandinavia.

Label: Fallschirmjäger
Text: Use at the beginning of your Play step. Discard the top 1 card of your draw deck to battle a land space adjacent to your Air Force.

Label: Sweden Supports Finland
Text: To use, Germany or the Soviet Union must have an Army in Russia. Build a Navy in the Baltic and recruit an Army in Scandinavia.

Label: 12.8cm Flakzwilling 40
Text: Use when an Allied player gains air superiority to eliminate an Italian Air Force. The Air Force used to gain air superiority is eliminated.

Label: Elektroboot Submarines
Text: The Allied country of your choice must discard the top 1 card of its draw deck. Gain +2 Victory Points.

Label: Tactical Innovations
Text: Use at the beginning of your Play step. Discard your Status card from the table to place a Status card from your hand on the table.

Label: Landkreuzers
Text: Use every time a German Army is battled. The country initiating the battle must discard the top 2 cards of its draw deck.

Label: Westwall
Text: Use every time an Axis Army is battled in Germany. The country initiating the battle must discard the top 3 cards of its draw deck.

Label: Sea Lion
Text: Build a Navy in the North Sea, then battle the United Kingdom space.

Label: Production Initiative
Text: Take your choice of 1 Status card from your draw deck and play it. Then shuffle your draw deck.

Label: Cloud Cover
Text: Use at the beginning of your Play step. Air Defense cannot be used this turn.

Label: Strategic Planning
Text: Take your choice of 1 or 2 cards from your draw deck and add them to your hand, then discard 1 card from your hand. Shuffle your draw deck.

Label: The Blitz
Text: Use when you play an Economic Warfare card. The United Kingdom must discard the top 2 cards of its draw deck for each German Air Force within 2 spaces of the United Kingdom.

Label: Ju-87
Text: Use when you deploy or marshal an Air Force. Discard the top 1 card of your draw deck to battle a land space adjacent to that Air Force.

Label: Turkey Joins Axis
Text: Build a Navy in the Black Sea, then recruit an Army in the Middle East.

Label: Arkhangelsk Falls
Text: To use, the Axis must have Armies in both Scandinavia and Russia. The Soviet Union must discard the top 5 cards of its draw deck. Gain +1 Victory Point.

Label: Fall Weiss
Text: Discard the top 1 card of your draw deck to recruit an Army in Eastern Europe. Then play another card from your hand.

Label: G7e Torpedo
Text: Use when you play an Economic Warfare card with the word "Submarines" in the title. Discard the top 1 card of your draw deck to battle a sea space.
